boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe outings with documented free admission or no Pennsylvania state-park day-use fee.

cards.title: See art at Aughinbaugh Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Climenhaga Building, Messiah University
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before heading to the Climenhaga Building, then take time to look closely and compare a few works together.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery for a self-paced art stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah states that its galleries, including Aughinbaugh Art Gallery, are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Messiah lists Aughinbaugh hours as Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; evening/weekend access is tied to High Center events.

cards.title: Browse the High Center Gallery
cards.subtitle: High Center, Messiah University
cards.notes: Meet in the High Center and make a slow circuit of the gallery displays; use the posted exhibition information as a prompt for conversation.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery walk in the High Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah states that the High Center Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Messiah lists High Center Gallery hours as 7 a.m.–10 p.m. daily, with holiday closure information on the gallery page.

cards.title: Walk through Climenhaga Galleries
cards.subtitle: Climenhaga Building, Messiah University
cards.notes: Pair a gallery visit with a quiet campus walk, pausing at pieces that invite a second look or a shared interpretation.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah states that the Climenhaga Galleries are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Messiah lists Climenhaga Galleries hours as 7 a.m.–10 p.m. daily, subject to the gallery's stated holiday closure.

cards.title: Catch a free movie at Parmer Cinema
cards.subtitle: Parmer Cinema, Messiah University
cards.notes: Look for the weekend showing, invite a few friends, and arrive with enough time to settle in before the program begins.
cards.short_summary: A university-listed weekend movie option with no ticket cost.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah says students can take in a free movie in Parmer Cinema on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Messiah identifies this as a weekend activity; confirm the current campus-events listing for a specific screening.

cards.title: Hike Lakeside Trail
cards.subtitle: Gifford Pinchot State Park, Lewisberry
cards.notes: Choose a section that suits your group and carry water; the route has some wet, remote sections even though many segments are easy walking.
cards.short_summary: A named 8.5-mile park loop with lake views.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR identifies Lakeside Trail as an 8.5-mile loop at Gifford Pinchot State Park; Pennsylvania state parks have no entrance or day-use fees.
cards.source_title: Hiking at Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.access_notes: Use the park map and daylight conditions to choose a segment; DCNR describes the full loop as most difficult.

cards.title: Take the Alpine Trail
cards.subtitle: Conewago Day Use Area, Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.notes: Start on the east side of Conewago Day Use Area and use this short, flat gravel connector for an easy walk-and-talk outing.
cards.short_summary: A half-mile trail with spring wildflowers.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR identifies Alpine Trail as a 0.5-mile hiking and biking trail at Gifford Pinchot State Park; Pennsylvania state parks have no entrance or day-use fees.
cards.source_title: Hiking at Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.access_notes: DCNR lists modern restrooms and picnic tables at the trailhead; bring any equipment you plan to use.

cards.title: Explore Beaver Creek Trail
cards.subtitle: Gifford Pinchot State Park, Lewisberry
cards.notes: Wear sturdy shoes and go with a friend; DCNR notes this wooded out-and-back can be muddy and rocky after wet weather.
cards.short_summary: A 1.5-mile trail through wetlands and woods.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR identifies Beaver Creek Trail as a 1.5-mile hiking route at Gifford Pinchot State Park; Pennsylvania state parks have no entrance or day-use fees.
cards.source_title: Hiking at Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.access_notes: The trail is rated most difficult by DCNR and has no listed trailhead amenities; plan for daylight and weather.

cards.title: Walk Quaker Race Trail
cards.subtitle: Quaker Race Day Use Area, Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.notes: Begin at Quaker Race Day Use Area and make the three-mile loop with Lakeside Trail, allowing extra time for uneven terrain and one steep hill.
cards.short_summary: A named connector trail that links to Lakeside Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR identifies Quaker Race Trail as a 1.7-mile hiking trail at Gifford Pinchot State Park; Pennsylvania state parks have no entrance or day-use fees.
cards.source_title: Hiking at Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.access_notes: DCNR lists restrooms, picnic tables, and benches at the trailhead; the trail is rated more difficult.

cards.title: Stroll Oak Trail
cards.subtitle: Conewago Day Use Area, Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.notes: Use the short gravel connector as a low-key outdoor break, and stop at the diabase rock outcropping near the Environmental Learning Center.
cards.short_summary: A short, gently rolling woodland connector.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR identifies Oak Trail as a 0.4-mile hiking and biking trail at Gifford Pinchot State Park; Pennsylvania state parks have no entrance or day-use fees.
cards.source_title: Hiking at Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.access_notes: DCNR lists restrooms, potable water, picnic tables, and benches near this trail; bring any bike you intend to ride.

cards.title: Use an unreserved picnic pavilion
cards.subtitle: Quaker Race Day Use Area, Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.notes: Bring your own snacks or simply gather at an available pavilion; use only an unreserved space and leave it ready for the next group.
cards.short_summary: A lake-side day-use area with free first-come pavilions.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR says unreserved picnic pavilions at Gifford Pinchot State Park are free on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Picnicking at Gifford Pinchot State Park
cards.access_notes: Reserved pavilions have a fee; choose only an unreserved pavilion. The area includes accessible pavilions and a volleyball court.
